scientific_integrity: The four-season spectral ranking follows from an exact trace commutator. The contrasting growth signs are certified by an exact rational Taylor computation with an analytic error bound. The broad possibility of dispersal-induced growth and the three-factor cyclic/reversal trace invariances are prior knowledge and not represented as new. A general matrix-product theorem in unindexed literature might cover the finding.
scientific_limitations: Four distinct seasonal phases at most, two habitats, linear dynamics with positive symmetric exchange within each phase, fixed durations and rates; no asymmetric dispersal, nonlinear persistence, five-phase schedule, or general numerical control theorem.
title: Four-season ordering law for two-habitat population persistence
